headline: ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮದ್ಯ

frames.jtbd: After a poor night I want to note what happened while it is fresh, so I can describe it later.
frames.visualLimit: Poor sleep is a supported self-reported symptom, not a liver diagnosis. Enlarged selected fields from the symptom form; 3/5 is an example personal rating.
